pub struct Failure;
pub struct Error;
pub struct Wrapper<E>(pub E);
pub type Outcome<T> = core::result::Result<T, Failure>;
pub struct SearchResult;

impl core::fmt::Display for Failure {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str("failure")
    }
}

impl core::fmt::Debug for Failure {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        f.write_str("Failure")
    }
}

impl<E: core::fmt::Display> core::fmt::Display for Wrapper<E> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        core::fmt::Display::fmt(&self.0, f)
    }
}

// Neither a trait nor a type gains core formatting capabilities from its name.
pub trait Display {
    fn display(&self) -> Outcome<()>;
}
impl Display for Error {
    fn display(&self) -> Outcome<()> { Ok(()) }
}
